title: LSVD: Loss-Aware Low-Rank Approximation for Efficient Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.00573v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) deliver strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their large computational cost and high parameter counts make deployment challenging on resource-constrained devices. Low-rank decomposition has emerged as a promising compression technique, yet existing methods often optimize local matrix reconstruction error, rely on uniform or heuristic rank allocation, and focus mainly on attention projections while leaving feed-forward networks underexplored. In this paper, we propose~\textit{LASER} (\textbf{L}oss-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}ingular-value d\textbf{E}composition and \textbf{R}ank allocation), a low-rank compression framework for efficient low-precision VLM inference. LASER derives a curvature-weighted SVD objective from a second-order approximation of the model loss and uses Kronecker-factored Fisher information to guide decomposition toward downstream performance rather than reconstruction alone. translated_title: LSVD：面向高效低精度视觉语言模型的损失感知低秩近似
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）具备强大的多模态推理能力，但其高昂的计算成本和庞大的参数量使其难以在资源受限的设备上部署。低秩分解已成为一种有前景的压缩技术，然而现有方法通常只优化局部矩阵重构误差，依赖均匀或启发式的秩分配策略，并且主要关注注意力投影，而对前馈网络的探索不足。在本文中，我们提出了 LASER（损失感知奇异值分解与秩分配），这是一个用于实现高效低精度 VLM 推理的低秩压缩框架。LASER 从模型损失的二阶近似中推导出曲率加权的 SVD 目标函数，并利用 Kronecker 分解的 Fisher 信息来引导分解过程朝向下游任务性能优化，而非仅仅追求重构误差最小化。
tldr: 提出了 LASER 框架，通过基于模型损失二阶近似的曲率加权 SVD 目标函数和 Kronecker 分解 Fisher 信息引导的秩分配，实现面向高效低精度推理的视觉语言模型低秩压缩。
en_tdlr: LASER is a loss-aware low-rank compression framework that derives a curvature-weighted SVD objective from a second-order approximation of model loss and uses Kronecker-factored Fisher information to guide rank allocation, enabling efficient low-precision VLM inference.
